rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name and ZIP lookup and accessed the user’s orders, acting on the correct account. However, it executed cancellations of two pending orders without first confirming the action with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the agent supplied a cancellation reason (“ordered by mistake”) without asking the user, and stated refund details (credit card, 5–7 business days) without visible tool-backed confirmation. These constitute unsupported/fabricated details and a procedural violation, so the outcome fails the pass bar.
